title: Metric cadence harmonizer: align scrape/export windows and stabilize per-model KPIs
creator: Priya Nambiar
description:
Problem: Our downstream SLO dashboards (per-model p50/p95/p99 latency, request error rates) show high-frequency jitter and spurious regressions after we introduced request-level batching and multiple telemetry sources. Root causes include: mismatched Prometheus scrape intervals vs OTel export cadence, non-deterministic label ordering for model_version/model_variant, and bursts from transient warm-ups or bursty batch flushes. Impact: noisy alerts, unnecessary rollbacks of rollouts, and difficulty comparing historical baselines across releases.

Goal: Build a small, deployable 'metric cadence harmonizer' component that ingests OTLP metrics and Prometheus scrape-derived metrics, resamples/normalizes them into fixed aligned windows, applies lightweight noise filtering for warmups, and emits a consistent stream to our TSDB (Prometheus remote_write or Cortex/Thanos ingest). The harmonized output should make per-model KPIs stable across backend changes and preserve cardinality and high-resolution quantiles required by SLOs.

Non-goals: This ticket does not replace metric sharding, long-term retention policy changes, or heavy aggregation logic for long-range analytical queries.
acceptance_criteria: Harmonizer service receives OTLP and Prometheus-derived metrics and writes aligned windows to remote_write with <= 2s additional processing latency
Per-model p99 latency across three test models shows 30% reduction in variance over a 24h window during synthetic burst tests
Dashboards (latency/error by model) show fewer false-positive SLO breaches during rollout simulation (reduced alerts by >= 40%)
Label normalization rules documented and applied (model_id, model_version, region, host) so metric joins are deterministic
Unit and e2e tests for resampling logic and warmup filtering added; code reviewed and merged
Runbook updated describing how to toggle harmonizer on/off and fallback to direct ingestion
tasks: Design resampling window semantics (configurable fixed windows: 1s/5s/15s) and alignment policy
Implement label normalization + deterministic ordering for metrics with model_* labels
Implement warmup/first-N-requests noise filter and optional burst dampening policy
Add otlp receiver and prometheus-scrape adapter input plugins (standalone or sidecar mode)
Implement remote_write exporter and compatibility layer for Cortex/Thanos
Add feature flag and gradual rollout plan with traffic mirroring for validation
Create Grafana dashboards and automated smoke queries for variance and anomalies
Add e2e tests simulating batching effects and rollout scenarios

notes_summary: Implement a compact harmonizer to align metric windows and normalize labels to reduce noise introduced by batching and mixed telemetry sources. Prioritize low-latency, non-lossy behavior and provide safe toggles for rollback.
